ownership_reason: Only the gold builds the entries of the options table (the entry column of each option's names and argument, the widest column, the description column) and it prints each entry to the writer itself. Hop 2 only lists the options (an empty set prints an empty line), hop 3 only sorts them, hop 4 passes them on, and hop 1 prints the other sections of the help; no caller can pre-filter or recover the entry column, because the gold reads the names from the options, leftPad is one value for every entry, and the gold's output goes straight to the writer. In the formatter's options table an option with no short name is indented by three spaces so that its long name stands under the long names of the options written as '-s,--name'; the variant writes it in the column of the short names. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the intact sibling HelpFormatter.renderOptions does the same step ("   " + defaultLongOptPrefix for an option whose getOpt() is null) and is the body of the public HelpFormatter.printOptions; HelpFormatterTest::testPrintOptions pins the table layout on that path, and BugsTest::test21215 (an empty table) passes through the chain.
